# WSI Cleaning

> WSI Cleaning is a Brisbane-based exterior cleaning company servicing Greater Brisbane, including Logan and Ipswich, in Queensland, Australia. Founded in 2014. ABN 14 608 887 850. $20 million public liability insurance. Phone 0451 371 212 (+61 451 371 212). Email info@wsicleaning.com. Rated 4.9 on Google.

## Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://wsicleaning.com/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs only. Ads landing pages and /thank-you/ are excluded.

## Services

- [House Washing](https://wsicleaning.com/house-washing/): Soft-wash cleaning of rendered, painted, brick and weatherboard homes.
- [Pressure Washing](https://wsicleaning.com/pressure-washing/): High-pressure cleaning of driveways, paths, patios and concrete.
- [Window Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/window-cleaning/): Interior and exterior glass, frames, sills and screens.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/gutter-cleaning/): Gutter clearing and downpipe flushing before storm season.
- [Roof Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/roof-cleaning/): Soft-wash treatment of tile, terracotta and metal roofs.
- [Driveway Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/driveway-cleaning/): Pressure cleaning of concrete, exposed aggregate and pavers.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/solar-panel-cleaning/): Deionised-water cleaning of rooftop solar panels.
- [Strata Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/strata-cleaning/): Exterior maintenance for body corporate properties.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://wsicleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/): Exterior washing for offices, warehouses and shopfronts.

## Service areas

- [Brisbane](https://wsicleaning.com/brisbane/): Greater Brisbane, including Logan and Ipswich.
